summary: 'See you later' moves the SEE sign (a V at the eyes) forward, then signs LATER. A standard casual goodbye.
steps: Sign SEE: a V handshape with the fingertips near your eyes, moving forward.
Sign LATER: an L handshape that tips forward from the wrist.
Keep eye contact, then wave or turn away.
mistakes: Rushing SEE so it looks like a point. Keep the V clear.
